verdicts.reason: A is clean and has no collisions, but the headline is undersized and the huge product circle overpowers it. 'Out now.' is tiny and floats off on its own at the bottom right, away from the headline it belongs to, so the CTA row looks unbalanced. B has a strong, readable headline, but the product circle is cropped by the top and left canvas edges and crammed into the corner, leaving the top-right empty. Its 'Out now.' is indented and doesn't line up with the headline's left edge, and the oversized 'Try It' pill competes with the headline, so the bottom feels heavy and cramped.
